title: Sable: Ragdoll Dummies
description: Spawn ragdoll dummies without the use of commands
body:
Sable: Ragdoll Dummies is an addon for Sable: Ragdolls that adds a new **Ragdoll Dummy** item, letting you spawn dummies without the need for commands!

This mod requires **Sable** and **Sable: Ragdolls** to function properly.

## Features

You can craft the Ragdoll Dummy item with a carved pumpkin and armor stand!
![Ragdoll Dummy Crafting Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef7dd50b1931a90d05276c42d7d8442aa3babd03.png)

By renaming the Ragdoll Dummy item to a player's username in an anvil, it changes the skin!
![Renaming the Ragdoll Dummy to Notch](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/07dd2ad4e39ef012dba3cb36cb553fa77c8258b6.png)

Simply right click on the ground to place the ragdoll down!
![Now the dummy looks like Notch!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/486df3d732738302e89748853bceff335bfaf5cc.png)

## Disclaimer

**There currently isn't a straightforward way to remove the ragdolls, so the best way to do it is by going into the Sable: Ragdolls config and enabling the despawn option!**

**You do not need this mod to spawn ragdoll dummies! Sable: Ragdolls already comes with commands to spawn them in, this mod only makes the process survival-friendly.**
